fact: On 10 May 2025 the Libyan Post, Telecommunications and IT Holding Company launched the Medusa submarine cable project in Misrata, to link Libya to Europe over an 8,700 km cable, improving internet in Tripoli, Misrata and Benghazi.
title: الشركة القابضة للاتصالات تعلن تدشين مشروع الكابل البحري (ميدوسا)
